uart.signal: stock STM32duino sketch (ststm32@19.7.1, nucleo_c031c6) prints LW_L0_OK through USART2 (PA2, ST-LINK VCP) after the HSE 48 MHz switch; the matrix asserts the UART sink contains it (examples/nucleo-c031c6/evidence/arduino-matrix).

spi.signal: stock SPI.transfer on SPI1 reads the MAX31855 device's own 32-bit frame (exact default frame required for LW_L4_OK).

i2c.signal: stock Wire on I2C1 (PB8/PB9) reads the INA219's CONFIG 0x399F and BUS 0x19CA registers (exact tier; a full run shows no LW_L3_PARTIAL_NO_RX).
